item.title: Mistfall Hunter: Best Solo Class
item.description:
Mistfall Hunter is a PvPvE extraction shooter that you can play both solo and in trios. While playing in a squad allows players to balance out class weaknesses, solo runs demand an independent kit that can clear PvE threats, control engagement distances, and escape deadly third-party ambushes. I'll be recommending some of the best solo classes in Mistfall Hunter that will not only increase your survivability in matches, but also let you dish out crazy amounts of damage if you master them.

Mistfall Hunter Twitch Drops: Rewards & How to Claim

Mistfall Hunter Twitch Drops are offering weapon chests, resources, and exclusive cosmetics as rewards, here's how to claim all the featured rewards.

By Ayyoun Ali

Best Solo Classes in Mistfall Hunter

Shadowstrix: Best Overall Solo Class for Stealth & Escapes

The Shadowstrix sits at the absolute top of the solo meta in Mistfall Hunter because it offers the one thing isolated players need most: stealth over engagements. Without teammates to watch your back, you can survive entirely by dictating when a fight happens. The rogue-inspired kit will let you bypass tough elite mobs, safely scout extraction points, and instantly disengage if you are ambushed by third parties.

Here are some key abilities that will be vital in securing wins during solo runs.

  1. Sneak (Invisibility) : Grants vital stealth that allows you to drop enemy aggro, slip past guarding mobs, and orchestrate perfect ambushes against unsuspecting players.
  2. Crow Storm : A unique offensive tool utilizing crows that help overwhelm targets during a duel, making it excellent for chunking down an enemy's health rapidly.
  3. Poison Crow Mark : Applies devastating poison effects to your target, which is incredibly useful for weakening even the tankiest of enemies in prolonged 1v1 fights while you remain elusive.

Blackarrow: Best Ranged Solo Class for Kiting & Distance Control

For players who prefer a highly tactical, ranged approach, the Blackarrow dominates by refusing to let enemies get near you. Armed with a bow and javelin, your survivability comes from keeping threats at a distance and securing the high ground. This class excels at safely clearing PvE camps from afar and punishing aggressive melee fighters who blindly push your position.

Here are some of the best Blackarrow abilities that will come in handy in both solo PvE and PvP confrontations.

  • Shadow Step : A crucial repositioning skill that lets you instantly dodge incoming attacks and relocate to safer high ground before a melee fighter can close the gap.
  • Scattershot : Fires a shotgun-style blast of seven arrows in a wide arc, providing massive burst damage to instantly punish anyone who manages to get too close.
  • Storm-Imbued Arrows : Modifies your shots to cause stagger and knockback effects, completely disrupting an enemy's advance and giving you the space needed to escape.

Mercenary: Best Versatile Solo Class for Beginners

If you want a brawler playstyle with a good mix of mobility and defense, the Mercenary stands out as one of the most accommodating solo Mistfall Hunter classes. It is less reliant on hiding and more focused on versatile melee combat. Whether using a Hammer or a Sword and Shield, the Mercenary can comfortably farm PvE content and survive sudden PvP ambushes without needing a dedicated support teammate.

Here are some key Mercenary abilities that will help you dominate both PvP and PvE combat situations.

  • Hammer Dash & Earthshaker : When equipped with the Hammer, you can use Hammer Dash for strong forward thrust, followed by Earthshaker to unleash massive AoE damage against groups of enemies.
  • Perfect Block : When wielding the Sword and Shield, this defensive ability allows you to parry incoming attacks, giving you a massive survival advantage in tight, close-quarters PvP duels.
  • Stacked Slash : By attacking with your sword, you accumulate "Sword Tip" stacks that can be spent on this powerful strike, letting you quickly finish off staggered enemies.

item.title: Mistfall Hunter Victory Wine Buffs Explained
item.description:
The Tavern is one of the first Camp Buildings you need to upgrade in Mistfall Hunter , since it unlocks the Victory Wine , consumables that players can drink prior to their runs, which provide useful buffs called Affixes that players need to complete their builds. Affixes are critical to make your character stronger, and unlocking them all is just the first step to becoming a truly strong Gyldhunter.

If you want to know everything about how the Victory Wine buffs work in Mistfall Hunter , and are in need of knowing how to upgrade the Tavern, and what the effects of the Affixes are in the game, then this guide can help you. It contains everything you need to know about Affixes, which stats they alter, and which are best suited for every class in the game.

More Mistfall Hunter Guides
Mistfall Hunter: Tips & Tricks
Mistfall Hunter: Withered Knight Guide
Mistfall Hunter: Shadowstrix Guide

How Tavern Buffs Work in Mistfall Hunter

Tavern Buffs, also known as Victory Wine, are consumables that players can use in the Camp's Tavern prior to every expedition in Mistfall Hunter . Victory Wine comes in four different tiers; each of them requires rarer ingredients, and to upgrade the Tavern to the next level:

  • Mortal Tonic : The Basic, free-to-craft tier provides only 2 Affixes.
  • Hero's Ale : Requires ingredients, provides 4 Affixes.
  • War Blood : Requires rarer ingredients, provides 5 Affixes, and you can now stack them for more powerful effects.
  • Gods Brew : Requires epic-grade ingredients, provides 6 Affixes, and allows you to stack them.

So, in the end, it is all about upgrading your Tavern, and unlocking more Affixes, and more options to stack them. Plus, you need to drink this every time prior to an expedition. Comparatively speaking, it is a similar system to that of Monster Hunter Meals.

With that said, now comes the fun part: Stacking Victory Wine Affixes with Equipment Affixes to complete our builds in Mistfall Hunter .

All Affixes & Their Effects in Mistfall Hunter (Tier List)

As mentioned before, Affixes can also be found in Equipment like Weapons, Armor, and Accessories. Getting the correct Affixes for your character is the only way to survive the merciless Endgame and hardcore PvP in Mistfall Hunters .

By subscribing, you agree to receive newsletter and marketing emails, and accept our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. You can unsubscribe anytime.

To save you a lot of time, here's a Tiered List of all Affixes in the game, plus their effects and which classes benefit most from them:

  • S Tier: Perfect or near-perfect Affixes. The Meta builds are mostly composed of these.
  • A Tier: Good enough to be considered Meta, but not as strong as S-Tier.
  • B Tier: Good for either PvP or PvP, but not both.
  • C Tier: Situational/Trash, depending on the class.
  • D Tier: Absolute Trash. Avoid picking it.

item.title: Wordle Today: Every Wordle Solution for August 2026
item.description:
Wordle took the world by storm in late 2021 and remains relevant to this day. Millions of people continue to play the popular word game on a daily basis, all in the hopes of keeping their solving streaks alive for as long as possible. Sometimes, however, difficult Wordle puzzles can put those solving streaks in jeopardy, forcing players to resort to desperate measures in order to find the solution to today's Wordle .

Today's Connections Answers

Find today's NYT Connections answers, including all four category groups and solutions.

By Tom Bowen

Some might prefer to be given clues to help them solve the puzzle for themselves, but for those who have already used up five of their six guesses, simply being given the answer to today's Wordle puzzle may be the better option. Those people are in luck, as this guide will provide the solution to today's NY Times Wordle , as well as all of the other Wordle solutions for the month of August 2026.

Warning: The following guide contains spoilers for all August Wordle solutions .

What's the Answer to Today's Wordle?

What's the Answer to Tomorrow's Wordle?

How to Play the NYT Wordle

In Wordle , your aim is to guess a five-letter word in six attempts or fewer . Each time you submit a guess, the game gives you feedback by changing the color of the tiles to show how close you are to the daily NYT Wordle solution. Green means the letter is in the correct spot, yellow means that the letter is correct but in the wrong spot, and gray means the letter does not feature in today's Wordle . When the game first started, previous Wordle answers were never repeated, but that all changed in February of 2026. Wordle answers can now be repeated, and the same letter may be used more than once, so you should keep these things in mind while making your guesses.

Basic Wordle Strategy

  • Start Strong: Most players choose a Wordle starting word with plenty of vowels and common consonants (like "ARISE," "ABUSE," "ADIEU," "CRANE," or "POINT") to eliminate as many letters as possible right away.
  • Process of Elimination: Pay attention to the virtual keyboard on the screen. It will highlight which letters you've already used and which ones are definitely not in the Wordle today.

The History of Wordle

Wordle started life as a low-key passion project for Welsh software engineer Josh Wardle, who wanted to create a word game for his puzzle-loving partner. It was meant to be a private gift, but was so successful that it quickly moved beyond their household, catching on with their families and friends before exploding across the internet. By late 2021, the game's iconic green-and-yellow grid was everywhere. The genius was in the restraint. With no ads and only one puzzle a day, it turned a solitary game into a regular habit, sending the demand for daily Wordle hints and solutions through the roof.

Wordle took the world by storm in late 2021 and remains relevant to this day. Millions of people continue to play the popular word game on a daily basis, all in the hopes of keeping their solving streaks alive for as long as possible. Sometimes, however, difficult Wordle puzzles can put those solving streaks in jeopardy, forcing players to resort to desperate measures in order to find the solution to today's Wordle .

Today's Connections Answers

Find today's NYT Connections answers, including all four category groups and solutions.

By Tom Bowen

Some might prefer to be given clues to help them solve the puzzle for themselves, but for those who have already used up five of their six guesses, simply being given the answer to today's Wordle puzzle may be the better option. Those people are in luck, as this guide will provide the solution to today's NY Times Wordle , as well as all of the other Wordle solutions for the month of August 2026.

Warning: The following guide contains spoilers for all August Wordle solutions .

How to Play the NYT Wordle

In Wordle , your aim is to guess a five-letter word in six attempts or fewer . Each time you submit a guess, the game gives you feedback by changing the color of the tiles to show how close you are to the daily NYT Wordle solution. Green means the letter is in the correct spot, yellow means that the letter is correct but in the wrong spot, and gray means the letter does not feature in today's Wordle . When the game first started, previous Wordle answers were never repeated, but that all changed in February of 2026. Wordle answers can now be repeated, and the same letter may be used more than once, so you should keep these things in mind while making your guesses.

Basic Wordle Strategy

  • Start Strong: Most players choose a Wordle starting word with plenty of vowels and common consonants (like "ARISE," "ABUSE," "ADIEU," "CRANE," or "POINT") to eliminate as many letters as possible right away.
  • Process of Elimination: Pay attention to the virtual keyboard on the screen. It will highlight which letters you've already used and which ones are definitely not in the Wordle today.
  • Double Letters: Keep in mind that NYT Wordle solutions can have duplicate letters (like "TREES," "CHECK," or "SPOON"). A yellow or green tile doesn't necessarily mean that a letter only appears once.
  • Protect Your Streak: For each consecutive day that you successfully solve a Wordle puzzle, your streak will increase by one. If it's starting to look as though you're going to run out of guesses, you may want to think about searching for " Wordle today GameRant" so that you can check this guide and keep your streak alive.

The History of Wordle

Wordle started life as a low-key passion project for Welsh software engineer Josh Wardle, who wanted to create a word game for his puzzle-loving partner. It was meant to be a private gift, but was so successful that it quickly moved beyond their household, catching on with their families and friends before exploding across the internet. By late 2021, the game's iconic green-and-yellow grid was everywhere. The genius was in the restraint. With no ads and only one puzzle a day, it turned a solitary game into a regular habit, sending the demand for daily Wordle hints and solutions through the roof.

It didn't take long for the New York Times to see the monetization potential, with the American publication spending over a million dollars to purchase the game in early 2022. There was plenty of drama at the time. Players were terrified that the NYT Wordle would suddenly become more difficult or end up locked away behind a paywall, but the soul of the game has remained mostly intact. Even years later, the morning rush for daily Wordle solutions remains a massive part of many players' lives and serves as a poignant reminder that even in a world of high-fidelity gaming, some people just want six rows and five letters to solve.

item.title: 5 Forgotten Single-Player Horror Games That Aged Like Fine Wine
item.description:
Horror is the most competitive genre in gaming, even though we barely get any major AAA releases besides Resident Evil and Silent Hill . From psychologically intense indie darlings to co-op escapades that produce more laughs than screams, new horror games constantly hit the scene, overwriting our memories of great fright-fests from yesteryear.

As terrifying or fun as modern titles can be, most of them don't hold a candle to a few forgotten horror games that have slipped through the cracks. These games have been largely erased from our collective consciousness, their presence reduced to nostalgia pieces like this article and maybe the occasional nightmare. Let's change that, and let's focus specifically on single-player horror games, since most modern releases focus on multiplayer.

Naturally, these horror games are remembered by those people who originally played them. However, I cannot imagine they are being discovered by new players.

Condemned: Criminal Origins Has The Best Melee Combat Of Any Horror Game

And A Pretty Good Story Too

  • A horror franchise that should be on its 5th entry, but stalled after just two.

Full disclosure: Condemned: Criminal Origins is in my top 5 favorite horror games, so the bias is strong with this one. That said, I replayed this recently, and it has stood the test of time. The sequel isn't bad either, but it doesn't hit the same highs as its predecessor and suffers from being a console-exclusive.

Putting aside my rose-tinted glasses, Condemned was such a breath of fresh air in 2005, for both the horror genre and gaming in general. While featuring quite a bit of action, Condemned forces you to really get your hands bloody by primarily focusing on vicious melee attacks. Horror should be unpleasant and discomforting, and this game forces those feelings upon you .

Story-wise, Condemned is better than most. FBI agent Ethan Thomas's homicide case leads him into a run-in with a serial killer who kills other serial killers, and the latter frames the former for the murder of two cops. Wanted by his own people, Ethan must head to the city's most decrepit corners to clear his name, all the while investigating a mass psychosis that turns people into violent murderers.

That's an awesome premise, and the execution does not fail to live up to that potential. The brutal melee combat reflects Ethan's desperation, and you even have access to forensic tools to investigate crime scenes for clues. All these elements combine to create a short but thrilling ride that sticks with you.

10 Best Horror Games That Prioritize Combat

These great horror games prioritize intense combat, mixing explosive action with intense psychological dread.

2
By Amy Cowley

Cold Fear Wasn't Just Resident Evil 4 On A Boat

Also, One Of The Best Horror Games On A Boat

  • Launched two months after Resident Evil 4 .

Even at the best of times, a horror game doesn't want to come out near Resident Evil , and 2005 might have been the worst year to drop an action hybrid that clearly takes inspiration from Capcom's franchise. While it came out too close to RE4 to be a direct copycat, Cold Fear essentially tried to do the exact same thing: push classic survival horror into a modern action direction with an over-the-shoulder camera .

A good horror story needs a good setting, and Cold Fear has that in the form of an abandoned whaling vessel filled with the reanimated corpses of its crew. Tom Hansen is charged with investigating the ship, and he quickly finds himself on a containment mission that goes well beyond his pay grade. Darkworks went out of its way to create as realistic an environment as possible; in fact, the developer went a bit too far by constantly shifting the level geometry to simulate the ship movement, a feature that might trigger motion sickness in some folks.

I am one of those folks. Cold Fear is so far the only non-VR game that motivated me to take a motion sickness pill.

Cold Fear might be more than two decades old by this point, but its gameplay can stand alongside most modern shooters without any trouble. Unlike RE4 , you can move while aiming, making the moment-to-moment gunplay feel a lot better while also allowing it to age gracefully.

Clive Barker’s Undying Expertly Blends Horror And FPS Gameplay

A Horror Game Worthy Of Clive Barker's Name

  • Flopped at launch, largely due to poor marketing.

As the mind behind Hellraiser , Candyman , and a million other masterpieces, Clive Barker's name holds tons of weight in the horror community, but his games are generally seen as a "lesser" part of his legacy. His most well-known association is Clive Barker's Jericho , a legendary mess that is kind of worth playing, as long as you go in with low expectations. However, that game's spiritual predecessor, Undying ​​​​​​, is a straight-up fantastic FPS horror game that deserves way more love and appreciation.

Set in 1923, you play Patrick Galloway, a World War I veteran and paranormal investigator summoned to a coastal estate in Ireland by his dying friend, Jeremiah Covenant. As a child, he took part in an occult ritual with his siblings, unwittingly releasing a curse that begins to wipe them all out, only to revive them as something not quite alive or dead. The story isn't anything out of this world, but it is elevated by creepy, varied environments and thematic boss fights against Patrick's siblings.

Undying 's combat has aged surprisingly well , and it echoes BioShock 's dual-wielding system that combines a gun with something more unusual. In this case, players get to equip period-accurate weapons in one hand and unleash spells in the other, granting them a skillset that is still expansive by horror and even FPS standards.

The 10 Greatest Horror Adventure Games Of All Time, Ranked

Uncover the most influential horror adventure games, ranked by their innovative storytelling, atmosphere, and psychological horror elements.

By Sharon Smith

The Suffering Should Be More Than Just A Horror Footnote

The Ultimate Prison Escape

  • Midway Games and Surreal Software's closure pretty much killed this series.
  • Both The Suffering games were delisted from GOG in 2024.

I'm slightly hesitant to mention The Suffering , considering it isn't an easy game to acquire nowadays; however, I imagine a number of people who picked up the game and its sequel before they left GOG have yet to play them. If you have The Suffering sitting idle in your library, it might be time to hit "install."

Making a great two-parter with Condemned: Criminal Origins , The Suffering is another action-heavy horror game that basks in gore and violence. Rather than an FBI agent, you portray a family annihilator who has no memories of the murders, and Torque arrives at Abbot State Penitentiary on Carnate Island just before an earthquake unleashes a bunch of monsters fueled by the island's dark history. Escape means surviving through hell.

With help from Stan Winston Studios to design the monsters, The Suffering 's enemy gallery oozes vile creativity, and it's the perfect antidote for those bored to death by zombies or ghosts. Besides the top-notch roster of terrors, the game maintains a quick, unrelenting pace that accommodates both action and psychological horror. Really great stuff.

​​​​​​​Siren Is Still A One Of A Kind Horror Game

Be It 2003 Or 2026, You Will Either Love Or Hate It

  • Specifically Siren , not Siren: Blood Curse . The PS3 remake is a fine horror game, but it sanitized the original in a way that stripped away what made it so unique.

Let's end things with a weird case. Siren is the definition of a love-or-hate experience, with nearly every element being polarizing. Some people find the game to be frustrating and confusing, a perfectly understandable reaction; conversely, others see Siren as an ambitious experiment driven by an unsettling atmosphere that really gets under your skin. The reasons to play this title now are the same as they were 23 years ago.

Set over a three-day period, Siren takes place in Hanuda, a deeply isolated, mountainous Japanese village cut off from the outside world by a supernatural red sea and an echoing siren. After a cult ritual goes wrong, the townsfolk become Shibito, strange immortal corpses that hunt down any survivors while rebuilding the village. Rather than a single protagonist, you control 10 characters, playing through their stories in a non-linear order set over a period of 72 hours.

One survivor's actions impact another's story, and you will find yourself having to shift between characters to complete puzzles. That's already a cool enough idea to warrant a playthrough, but Siren also has an innovative mechanic that lets you see the world through another person's eyes, even the Shibito.

item.title: Mistfall Hunter: Where Is The Secret Shop?
item.description:
After finishing the tutorial in Mistfall Hunter , you'll gain access to your base where numerous NPCs offer different services and shops. As you become familiar with the hub and begin exploring the various menus, you'll eventually come across the Keychains option. While browsing through it, you'll notice higher rarity Keychains that can be obtained through the Secret Shop .

Naturally, this leaves many players wondering where this shop is, how to unlock it, and the best ways to get these better Keychains. Here's everything you need to know.

Can You Change FOV in Mistfall Hunter?

Wondering if you can change the FOV in Mistfall Hunter? Here is everything you need to know about in-game slider options and camera settings.

2
By Ayyoun Ali

How to Unlock the Secret Shop in Mistfall Hunter

The Secret Shop isn't hidden somewhere out in the world. It's actually located right inside your hub alongside the other NPC vendors. Head over to Cazarro and interact with his shop. Inside the Purchase menu, you'll notice several tabs, one of which is the Secret Shop .

Unfortunately, you won't be able to access it immediately. Before it becomes available, you'll first need to upgrade Cazarro's Shop to Level 4 .

The table below lists every material required for each upgrade:

Level

Required Materials

Level 1 → 2

• Velgr Feather ×1

• Slime ×1

• Vine Bundle ×3

• Fishbone ×2

Level 2 → 3

• Gem Mirror ×1

• Pearl Dust ×2

• Needle Case ×2

• Herb Bundle ×2

Level 3 → 4

• Bloodstained Brooch ×2

• Thunder Ore ×2

• Fine Salt ×2

• Ornate Wooden Box ×2
